sourceText: User asked to add a version strategy after B-3a4d skipped the CLI version bump because no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed.
normalizedOutcome: B-3a4d-like stories that change CLI capability contract or proof files trigger a DONE patch-version bump, while unrelated documentation, experiments, paper artifacts, and manual semver edits remain outside the policy.
acceptanceClaim: The changed-path predicate returns true for docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/**, returns false for unrelated docs/requirements and experiments/**, the smoke test proves both sides, and story-lifecycle docs describe the bounded policy.
